mae: Quick heads-up — onboarding lynx42k-int4 (30k context). After a heavy prefill + induced KV shard eviction during generation the model output diverges and NLL spikes.

sachin: Where's the reproducer?

mae: Repro command below (deterministic seed). This reliably triggers when prefill >= ~28k and we force an eviction mid-stream.

mae: Repro:
```bash
mk-eval-runner --model lynx42k-int4 --seed 999 --prompt-file tests/longprime_large.txt --max-tokens 256 --prefill 30000 --evict-at-token 1024
```

mae: Snippet from logs: 
```text
[2026-03-22T13:05:10Z] kv_shard=2 kv_idx=45823 ropescale=0.999912
[2026-03-22T13:05:10Z] kv_shard=3 kv_idx=0   ropescale=1.000331  <-- unexpected discontinuity after stitch
[2026-03-22T13:05:11Z] delta_tokens=0.21 nll_pct_increase=+11.7
```

oliver: I ran a CPU sim and bisected to the int4 fused ropescale codepath (kernel v3.2). int8 path doesn't reproduce.

mae: Important: if I disable prefix caching the drift vanishes. So it's tied to kv restore/stitch not attention math itself.

mae: Running longbench prime_set_v8 showed average NLL +10-14% with cache enabled vs baseline without caching.

sachin: Hypothesis: when shards are evicted and later restored we recompute a per-shard rotary scaling factor using quantized accumulators, which rounds differently across shards and causes a small multiplicative mismatch at boundaries. Stitch code assumes ropescale continuity.

mae: Proposed mitigation: during kv_restore compute a reference ropescale from the leading shard and adjust subsequent shards by a multiplicative correction factor to align scales. Also add unit test that fails if post-restore token divergence > 1e-4.

oliver: I drafted PR #1278 that normalizes ropescale on restore and includes a unit reproducer tests/unit/test_kvcache_ropescale_eviction.py. Patch note: "normalize ropescale across shards on kv_restore for int4 fused kernels".

infra-bot: deploy/canary lynx42k-int4 reported regen drift threshold breach at 2026-03-22T13:12:00Z. Canary paused.

mae: Can someone run a small smoke (5 seeds) patched vs unpatched on a real GPU (p4d/g4dn) to confirm before we backport?

oliver: Running smoke now. Command: 
```bash
./scripts/bench_longprefill.sh --model lynx42k-int4 --patch pr-1278 --seeds 10 11 12 13 14 --prefill 32000 --evict-at-token 512 --out /tmp/lynx-smoke-pr1278
```

mae: Thanks. If patched run shows improved continuity and NLL back to baseline then we should backport to dedicated runtime and hold hosted rollout.

sachin: Also adding an integration gate in onboarding CI: any model with longprefill warming + eviction that shows >1% regen drift fails onboarding.

oliver: Quick update — patched smoke logs show ropescale diffs under 3e-5 and NLL delta within noise. Uploading logs: s3://redwood-ci/lynx42k/1766001234/smoke_logs.tar.gz

mae: Great. Plan: (1) finish full 20-seed eval on dedicated stage, (2) backport patch to runtime int4 handlers, (3) add regression test to onboarding harness, (4) coordinate canary unpause once verified.

deploy-bot: Canary create request queued for lynx42k-int4 with PR #1278.

mae: I'll monitor full eval. Ping me if anything weird pops up. :thumbsup:

sachin: Thanks all.
